The rail entry's name 'Admin' shows in its CMP-016 tooltip (frame A) from the kit label nav_admin (L188); the rail item is 'Admin' in CMP-071's list (15:696) and 10-personas.md L179.
CMP-061's role display ('role is always shown as visible text', 15:602-604) has no D03 string or format: no role line is drawn; the trigger shows the Owner's name as on every board.

live_checks: tooltip (frame A): the CMP-016 instance in 'overlay' at x 68, y 710: after relayout it sits right of the focused Admin entry (entry x 8-56, y 708-740), vertically centred on it (centre y 724; set y = 724 - h/2 if the instance is not 28 px tall), clear of the rail's divider at x 63; if the library tooltip carries an arrow on another side, report it (CMP-016 has a side prop, 15:190)
focus ring (frame A): the 'focus-ring' wrapper (56 x 40) stays inside the 64 px rail, at its foot (y 704-744 in the frame); the ring is 2 px color.focus.ring 2 px off the entry

menu (frame B): 'CMP-061 UserMenu (composition) · open' at x 1024, y 52 (estimated 240 x 136 px): its right edge on the trigger's (x 1264), its top 4 px under the TopBar; it must not overlap the palette
palette (frame B): 'CMP-059 CommandPalette (composition)' at x 400, y 256 (estimated 480 x 289 px): re-centre it in the frame after relayout; the 'focus-ring' around its input must not be clipped

captions: each 'source label' wraps inside its 1280 px column (estimated A 1 + 1 lines, B 1 + 1 lines); its frame starts 8 px under it; the columns are estimated 842 px. Frames A and B must start at the same y: caption B's source line is estimated at 1176 of 1280 px (A's at 1062); if it wraps, frame B sits 13 px lower than frame A: shorten that line (CAPTIONS['B'] in gen_08.py, then regenerate, so the sheet stays equal to the board)

annotations fit: the column is estimated at 1566 px in a 1696 px root (1664 inside its padding; k.root_size() plus 96 px of slack): after touchTexts and relayout the footer must lie inside the root (clip on); if not, raise the root height (pitch limit 1760) and report the new height so the sheet is regenerated with it
inst 'CMP-016 Tooltip': set 'CMP-016 · Tooltip', props {"State": "default"}, text layers ['content']: verify the set, the variant and the layer names live before rendering
glyph ◆ (U+25C6): confirm Inter draws it; else Penpot substitutes a fallback font
root name: after the first section call the root must read back exactly as the sheet's board.name, or later calls create a duplicate root
deviations: Board 08's frames are the Owner's SCR-010 (e42kit.app_shell), not the CMP-087 shell: SH-8 is the way in, before any admin route renders (§4 L188), and the shell is identical under either placement (D02:117).

Each frame sits under a caption naming its placement and source (Q5, 'each labelled with its source', §4 L188): the root row holds 'placement A' and 'placement B' (caption over frame) and the annotations, so the frames are not the root's direct children as the build notes list them.
Frame B draws the open CMP-061 menu and the open CMP-059 palette together so one frame shows both of R-D8's ways in; the product shows one at a time (CMP-059 is a modal dialog, 15:586).
No scrim under CMP-059: 15:586 names a modal dialog but no backdrop, and a scrim would hide frame B's open menu.

CMP-059 is a composition (no library set): 480 px wide (E10-D02's SCR-012 frames are 480 px), color.surface.overlay and elevation.dialog (= elevation.4, 15:587), radius.dialog, space.inset.sm padding and gaps (kit choice); the combobox well is the DS-3 text field with its search glyph in color.text.tertiary (§15 L650's pair); the active option binds color.surface.selected (the selected-row pair, 10.17, §15 L643) with an inner 2 px color.focus.ring, its visual focus under aria-activedescendant (as e42kit.table_row draws a focused cell; 4.72 on selected, §15 L640), so the state is never the fill alone.
CMP-059's group labels and every command but 'Admin area' are neutral placeholders: E10-D02's SCR-012 owns them (E10:104-106).

Focus is the board's choice, to show each way in: frame A focuses the Admin entry so its CMP-016 tooltip shows the name at 1280 (CMP-071, 15:698; E10:98); frame B's focus is in the palette's combobox, so no CMP-061 item is focused.
The CMP-061 menu is 240 px wide (e42kit.menu's width; no source gives CMP-061's) and sits 4 px under the TopBar, right-aligned with its trigger.

CMP-071 (15:699) and CMP-213 (15:2458) name color.surface.raised; the rail keeps the kit's color.surface.app chrome and the list CMP-059's overlay, so the focus ring reads 7.45 on app (§15 L640), not 6.66 on raised.

TopBar, NavRail, RightRail and StatusBar content other than the Admin entry, the env badges and the owner's name is drawn as neutral placeholders (E10-D02 owns it; §1 L97 gives only the sizes); the chrome binds color.surface.app with color.border.subtle dividers (no source names a chrome surface).

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

A focus ring is a 2 px color.focus.ring inner stroke on a wrapper with space.inset.xs (4 px) padding, so it sits 2 px off the control (CMP-039) inside the wrapper's bounds; its radius is the next step (radius.card around radius.control); the wrapper adds 4 px on each side to the layout.
Board names carry Penpot's normalised ' / ' form (E42-D03 / 31 SCR-121 / populated · …) so cvsheet's find-or-create root matches on every section call; §0 L46-47 writes 'SCR-121/populated'.
